title: ProofGate: Public Plans, Private Results
description:
A procurement employee needs to choose which supplier renewals to negotiate and what price to ask for. ProofGate lets actual AI compose a useful approved method while company records and decision rules determine the result locally.

In Blind Workbench, the employee asks for at most two renewals within 60 days, earliest first. Actual hosted AI chooses bounded approved operations and parameters from public intent and capabilities. The authenticated host admits the entire method through deterministic controls AND actual semantic AI inspection before private access. Synthetic private quotes, prices and rule bodies produce selected suppliers, negotiation ceilings and a useful brief inside the company-controlled host.

After private quotes and the price rule change, the independently expected selection changes from Near/Middle to Middle/Large. The retained actual method rebinds locally with zero new provider attempts and unchanged retained application bodies. The $130 to $1,060 observation is synthetic potential opportunity, never achieved savings or ROI. A separately observed employee-approved internal save matches one exact independent SQLite record. Stale saves and deliberately manual external exports have no forbidden effects.

ProofGate provides mutable policy and model allowance, supported input/output privacy controls, whole-source advisory quarantine, finite shared actor/checker/authentication/tool admission and observable audit/export. Unknown dispatched work stays charged and unreplayed. Observed token categories and unpriced tariff estimates stay separate from admission credits; detailed accounting preserves the original combined forecast overrun.

Actual composition, local rebind and historical save have separately dated evidence. Current UI captures are retained-run GET observations that establish no new inference, rebind or save. Four automated walkthroughs and the historical seven-capture paced backup are not human rehearsal or continuous interaction recording.

This is a bounded synthetic prototype. Public intent, capabilities, admitted advisory, method and transport metadata remain disclosed; arbitrary secrets pasted into public inputs and broad confidentiality are unproven. The local host and authenticated employee remain trusted. Inference is hosted-only Vertex, with no demonstrated local LLM or organizer waiver of the brief’s local-model expectation. Peripheral ERP/email integrations are mocks. Historical release-assistant on/off evidence showed no downstream causal benefit. Independent review, regression and canonical verification govern local candidate acceptance; no universal security or production readiness is claimed. Team contact, deployment readiness and external access remain owner-managed.

architecture: Authenticated loopback employee browser → owned host identity/current policy/shared ledger → stateless hosted advisory checker → hosted public planner → stateless whole-method checker → admitted bounded local interpreter on synthetic confidential records/rules → fixed private MCP internal save → separate SQLite effect recorder and read-only exact-content reconciliation. Public objectives/capability/transport metadata are disclosed; private records/rules/results are not sent to remote models in this bounded path.

environment.PROOFGATE_TOKEN: Generate a private random local gateway token of at least 16 characters; keep it out of Git, exports and captures.
environment.PROOFGATE_HOST_DB: Optional host path; default .proofgate/host.sqlite. Root manages the existing live store.
environment.PROOFGATE_FIXTURE_DB: Optional separate fixture path; default .proofgate/fixture.sqlite. Preserve prior effects.
environment.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS: Optional owned authorized-user ADC file; otherwise gcloud application-default authorized-user ADC. Never export its contents.
environment.PROOFGATE_ARTIFACT_PYTHON: Content/release only: absolute bundled Python executable resolved by the workspace dependency loader, with reportlab, pypdf and PIL. No application install or machine path is persisted.

hosted.credentials: Owned authorized-user ADC via gcloud auth application-default login. Service-account, federation and metadata transports are rejected by the supported adapter.
hosted.funding: Owner-funded access to the fixed project and allowed models, with reviewed same-epoch finite headroom. No organizer subscription assumed.
hosted.offline: npm test needs no ADC/provider network; injected transport/model mode establishes implementation behavior, not model quality. eval:hosted is opt-in, root-coordinated and paid; stale Phase02 approvals cannot be reused.

stores.recovery: Interrupted dispatched work remains charged; no restart/resume guarantee or automatic replay.

demo: Start supported loopback host http://127.0.0.1:3100 with owner-managed token and authorized ADC; root preserves existing live stores/epoch and controls any paid dispatch.

Inspect a retained actual hosted method; distinguish public objective/capabilities/advisory from confidential local worksheet and rules. Fresh composition is paid and requires the reviewed finite allocation.
Change a synthetic private quote/rule, rebind the retained admitted recipe, inspect correct changed brief and zero new provider attempts/unchanged exact public bodies.

A fresh internal save incurs tool attempts; refuse a labeled manual external export with zero sink effects, then inspect the exact independent internal read-back. The sanitized GET export is a separate allowed observation.
Reset synthetic worksheet at a higher workspace version; do not reset allowance or delete effects. Use the paced recorded backup only as dated observation with no new save.

retainedExperiment.conclusion: Source exposure changes; no observed downstream causal benefit.

limitations: Synthetic data only; no production-data clearance or public deployment.
Preparation-only internal draft; no dependency installation, execution of tests or deployment is established by the save.

No observed downstream causal benefit: both actual Phase02 on/off actors succeeded safely; four subjects and two arms, one attempt each, do not establish general accuracy or universal injection prevention.

Unknown observed prompt/output/thought/cache usage remains unknown; unpriced tariff stays null. Enforced conservative request/response/output admission credits are separate from tokens and estimated money, with no invoice cap guarantee.
Single owner-funded hosted-only Vertex backend. Local compute/time admission is a conceptual extension; no second operational inference backend.
No reset on new run, no paid automatic replay/retry; unknown dispatched work stays charged. Preserve stores, epoch and independent effects.
Offline injected runner executions are separate from actual hosted observations; duplicate imported registrations are executions, not unique attacks.
Restart/resume recovery, distributed capacity/queue scheduling, general MCP federation and arbitrary shell remain deferred.
Strictness and controls.flow are reserved compatibility metadata, disabled in the UI; structural provenance/audiences/internal-only boundaries remain enforced.
Historical records without measured duration/hardware remain unavailable; final measurement spans state workload, samples, hardware and requested/returned model identities.

Retained release-baseline desktop/tablet/mobile, keyboard, reduced-motion and download observations remain dated baseline evidence. Current 60-day-result viewport/export checks were observed at 2026-10-04T02:22Z; native keyboard and emulated reduced-motion checks at 02:27Z. The earlier GSD CLI Tab failure and original 3/4 favicon-only assertion are preserved. Current Phase05 UI audit is verified18/24 with zero blockers; current source matches independent canonical verification. Nonblocking JSON-editing and narrow-screen discoverability limitations remain; private team/account/submission details remain owner-managed.
Source brief/rules scoring weights and PM timing conflicts remain disclosed in goldman/TASK-CONTRACT.md.
Hosted-only actor/checker differs from the brief local-model expectation. A local interpreter is not a local LLM; no organizer approval of this mismatch is established.

The public objective, admitted advisory, capability vocabulary and transport/task metadata are disclosed. The bounded proof does not protect arbitrary secrets pasted into public inputs or establish protection of all company know-how.

Two prepared public objectives and one previously unprepared 60-day/two-earliest intention have actual composition evidence. This is a bounded supported-grammar proof, not superiority over forms, spreadsheets or fixed workflows.

Three dated automated browser walkthroughs used a retained actual hosted method, not fresh inference or human rehearsal. Fresh saves added 12 tool attempts/3150704 credits after 24 proof attempts/6502120 credits; 36 total attempts exceeded the original combined 32 forecast.

The replacement 48.933333-second backup is a paced sequence of seven real current 60-day UI captures, not continuous recording, human demo timing or achieved latency. Playback establishes no new save. Root inspected all seven captures and full-size frames 1 and 7 at 2026-10-04T02:23:18.750Z; captured worktree identity remains provisional. Prior 49-second prepared-workflow backup metadata is retained historically.

New public-intention proof used 8 attempts / 2150481 credits (3 model, 1 authentication, 4 MCP) under a separate 12-attempt / 4325376-credit allocation, in the same epoch. Its dated checkpoint is 324 calls / 87971452 credits with 10 historical unknowns and 0 active runs; the earlier 36/32 forecast discrepancy is unchanged.

A separately allocated fourth automated walkthrough reused the actual 60-day intention method: 4 tool attempts / 1050011 credits, zero model/authentication attempts; private quote-only result $1200 then rule-changed $1060; dated 328 calls / 89021463 credits, 10 unknowns unchanged. The original three prepared-workflow walkthroughs and 36/32 forecast discrepancy remain separate.
